newsitem.title: USA: WLR CEO says better turkey prices needed.
newsitem.headline: WLR CEO says better turkey prices needed.

text.p: WLR Foods Inc's chief executive James Keeler said the company's results might not improve as quickly as the company would like because of low turkey prices.
Keeler, in a statement included with the company's earnings, said the company needs to see a recovery in turkey prices for higher profits.
He said turkey prices are currently being held in check by excessive supplies caused by industry expansion. The supplies have outpaced the growth in demand for turkey, he added.
The company said it lost $0.30 per share in the second quarter, compared with a profit of $0.28 per share in the year-earlier period.
The company's shares in late morning trading stood at 12-3/4, down 1/4.
